description: Work-related death backfill for Cyprus Labor Watch. Recent named cases are recorded individually. Older official/research totals are recorded as annual aggregate markers with fatality_count values so they do not imply a single exact incident.

records.title: Hammad Pakistani dies after fall from sixth floor at Dortyol construction site
records.summary: Hammad Pakistani, a 26-year-old Pakistani worker, died after losing his balance and falling about 19 metres from the sixth floor of a construction site in Dortyol. Police said the investigation was continuing.
records.worker_name: Hammad Pakistani
records.cause: Fall from sixth floor of construction site
records.legal_status: Police investigation continuing according to source

locations.label: Dortyol construction site
locations.location_basis: Source places the fatal incident at a construction site in Dortyol; Famagusta area centroid used pending exact coordinates.

sources.title: Dortyol'da Insaat Faciasi: 26 Yasindaki Isci Hayatini Kaybetti

records.title: Giorgos Konstantinou dies in Germasogeia lift-shaft workplace fall
records.summary: Giorgos Konstantinou, a 43-year-old plumber from Limassol, was found dead in a lift shaft at a construction site in Germasogeia where he was working. Police and the Department of Labour Inspection investigated the fall and site safety conditions.
records.worker_name: Giorgos Konstantinou
records.cause: Fall into lift shaft at construction site
records.legal_status: Police and Department of Labour Inspection investigation reported

locations.label: Germasogeia construction site
locations.location_basis: Sources place the fatal incident at a construction site in Germasogeia; district centroid used pending exact site coordinates.

sources.title: Worker loses life after falling down lift shaft in Limassol
Fatal workplace accident at Limassol construction site
Plumber dies after fall in lift shaft at Limassol construction site

records.title: Polish worker found dead after fall at Kissonerga construction site
records.summary: A 26-year-old Polish man was found dead at the bottom of an elevator shaft in an incomplete two-storey building under construction in Kissonerga. The Labour Inspection Department suspended work after finding that some safety measures were not being followed.
records.worker_name: Name not published
records.employer: Construction contractor not named in source
records.cause: Fall from height into elevator shaft
records.legal_status: Work suspended after Labour Inspection Department safety check; possible extrajudicial fine under examination according to source

locations.label: Kissonerga construction site
locations.location_basis: Source places the death at an incomplete building in Kissonerga; district centroid used pending exact site coordinates.

sources.title: Construction worker died after falling from great height

records.title: Fatih Safakoglu killed during base-station installation work near Taskent
records.summary: Fatih Safakoglu, a 35-year-old worker from Bogazkoy, died at a Turkcell base-station worksite southeast of Taskent after a three-kilogram material being hoisted to a tower fell from about 20 metres and struck his head. Kibris Gercek reported that company representatives were brought to court and released pending trial with conditions.
records.worker_name: Fatih Safakoglu
records.employer: Natek Muhendislik Limited; work connected to KKTC Turkcell and Reon Teknoloji Limited according to source
records.cause: Struck by falling material during tower installation work
records.legal_status: Four suspects taken to court and released pending trial with conditions according to source

locations.label: Turkcell base station southeast of Taskent
locations.location_basis: Source places the worksite southeast of Taskent; area centroid used pending exact base-station coordinates.

sources.title: Fatih Safakoglu'nun vefati ile sonuclanan is kazasinin zanlilari mahkemeye cikarildi

records.title: Mustafa Kilinc dies after iron profiles fall in Gazimagusa warehouse
records.summary: Mustafa Kilinc, a 55-year-old worker, died after block profile irons fell on him from about two metres while being placed on shelves in a warehouse belonging to Ceten Yapi Market in Gazimagusa's Great Industrial Zone.
records.worker_name: Mustafa Kilinc
records.cause: Crushed by falling profile irons in warehouse
records.legal_status: Police investigation continuing according to source

locations.label: Ceten Yapi Market warehouse, Great Industrial Zone
locations.location_basis: Source places the death at Ceten Yapi Market's warehouse in Gazimagusa Great Industrial Zone, 3rd Street; industrial-area centroid used pending exact warehouse coordinates.

sources.title: Gazimagusa'daki is kazasinda Mustafa Kilinc hayatini kaybetti
